proposed_next_actions.question: Which fin cell states and biological replicates have usable paired measured data?
proposed_next_actions.method: Pin input byte hashes, genome/annotation identifiers and donor/stage/cell-label mappings; inspect small metadata before bulk matrix admission.
proposed_next_actions.bound: one CPU core,4GiB,60min; metadata only initially
proposed_next_actions.stop_rule: unresolved sample identity, assembly mismatch or download exceeding admitted size
proposed_next_actions.claim_boundary: No model inference, DNA design or causal mechanism demonstrated.

proposed_next_actions.question: Are existing basal-epithelial versus mesenchymal accessibility/RNA associations reproducible across declared biological replicates?
inputs: pinned GSE261907 processed matrices and labels
proposed_next_actions.method: Freeze cell filters and paired-stage contrast before outputs; biological-replicate pseudobulk; no split of cells from one donor as independent replication.
proposed_next_actions.bound: one CPU core,4GiB,4h after sparse input-size admission
proposed_next_actions.stop_rule: missing replicate identifiers, insufficient cells or incompatible labels remain explicit failures
proposed_next_actions.claim_boundary: Association only; no generated DNA or validated phenotype transfer.

proposed_next_actions.question: Can an applicable permitted predictor explain existing measured fish regulatory activity beyond GC/motif baselines?
inputs: full experimental methods and negative controls
proposed_next_actions.method: Preregister held-out loci and replicate splits; score ATAC and expression as separate endpoints; evaluate species-transfer failure explicitly.
outputs: held-out prediction metrics versus simple baselines
proposed_next_actions.bound: budget and model admission frozen only after labels/access permissions are established; no current dispatch
proposed_next_actions.stop_rule: missing experimental labels, unavailable methods, model-use restriction or provider rejection; no replay/reroute
proposed_next_actions.claim_boundary: No sequence generation; predictor quality is not organism feasibility.
